title: Material Blend 2-Mix Solo #08 (코이비늘+크리스탈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, silver-white locs cascading to her waist — her entire body, from neck to ankle, is a random intermingled mix of two materials with no spatial division at all — not left versus right, not top versus bottom, but irregular patches of each scattered all over her body in a marbled, organic distribution, exactly like natural mineral veining. koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow and ruby crystal clusters growing directly out of her own skin, erupting in true three-dimensional relief, each facet casting its own hard shadow, BLAZING RUBY RED crystal points, VIVID GOLD mineral veins are woven through each other everywhere: a patch of one material on one shoulder, immediately beside it a patch of the other, then the first again across the ribs, the second at the hip, the first down one thigh, the second across the opposite calf — the two materials never separating into a clean zone anywhere on her body, every square inch densely interlocking, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
